description: This file defines an enumeration 'SystemSettingsURLSupport' with a static method 'openFirst' that attempts to open the first URL from a list of candidate URLs, using macOS-specific AppKit frameworks.

classes.name: SystemSettingsURLSupport
classes.description: A utility enumeration providing a method to open system settings URLs on macOS.

methods.name: openFirst
methods.description: Attempts to open the first valid URL from a list of candidate URL strings.
